question_text:
The diagram shows a vertical pole [PQ], which is supported by two wires fixed to the horizontal ground at A and B. $\text{P}\widehat{\text{B}}\text{Q} = 36^\circ$, $\text{B}\widehat{\text{A}}\text{Q} = 70^\circ$, $\text{A}\widehat{\text{B}}\text{Q} = 30^\circ$, and the distance BQ is $40\text{ m}$.
Find:

mark_breakdown.desc: Using the tangent ratio in right-angled triangle $PQB$

subparts.solution: Let $PQ$ be $h\text{ m}$. $\tan 36^\circ = \frac{h}{40} \implies h = 40\tan 36^\circ \approx 29.1$. The height of the pole is about $29.1\text{ m}$.

step_by_step: Identify opposite side $h$ and adjacent side $40\text{ m}$ with angle $36^\circ$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Using sine or cosine instead of tangent when the hypotenuse is unknown.

subparts.stem: the distance between A and B.

mark_breakdown.desc: Applying the sine rule to find $x$

subparts.solution: Let $AB$ be $x\text{ m}$. $\text{A}\widehat{\text{Q}}\text{B} = 180^\circ - 70^\circ - 30^\circ = 80^\circ$ {angles in a triangle}. By the sine rule: $\frac{x}{\sin 80^\circ} = \frac{40}{\sin 70^\circ} \implies x = \frac{40\sin 80^\circ}{\sin 70^\circ} \approx 41.9$. The distance between $A$ and $B$ is about $41.9\text{ m}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Find missing angles using triangle angle sum, then apply the sine rule.
step_by_step: Set up the sine rule ratio: $\frac{x}{\sin 80^\circ} = \frac{40}{\sin 70^\circ}$.
Solve for $x$ and round to 3 significant figures.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Setting up the ratio using $30^\circ$ instead of $70^\circ$ opposite the $40\text{ m}$ side.
